observations.content: deploy-service is the CLI tool for managing all service deployments. Subcommands: deploy, rollback, status.
deploy-service connects to the deployment controller at deploy-service.internal:8443.
Authentication uses short-lived tokens from the auth provider. Tokens expire after 1 hour.
deploy-service status output is available at /tmp/brain-eval-a02/deploy-status.json.
inventory-api manages product catalog and stock levels. Current version: v2.3.0.
Last deployment was 3 days ago (v2.3.0). Deployment was successful, no rollback needed.
Health check endpoint: GET /healthz on port 8080.
Standard deploy procedure: 1) Check current status via deploy-service status. 2) Run pre-deploy tests. 3) Execute deploy-service deploy. 4) Verify health.
If deploy fails, run deploy-service rollback to revert to the previous version.
payments-api handles all transaction processing. Current version: v5.1.2.
payments-api depends on inventory-api for stock validation before processing orders.
notifications-service sends email and push notifications. Current version: v1.8.0.
notifications-service listens for deployment events from deploy-service.
